(
Wallet
The Wallet shows one profile at a time. The profile is chosen once, in the header: its avatar and label open Switch profile, the same list as Your profiles. With one profile there is nothing to switch. Everything on the page belongs to that profile: its balance, its royalties and rewards, its assets and its activity. Nothing is added up across profiles.
On a community's own address the Wallet is the same page: the whole wallet of the profile in use, not only what relates to that community. Accepted by the workspace_owner on 2026-10-12, loosely.
Switching profile closes an open Send or Receive sheet, as the app does, so a sheet never shows one profile's address or balance under another's name.
Top to bottom: Balance with Receive and Send, then Royalties and Rewards side by side (label, amount, Claim), then Assets, then Activity. The two claim cards are always there; with nothing to claim they read 0 and Claim is disabled. Sending and claiming cross screens, so they are Flows/Wallet/Send and Flows/Wallet/Claim. Nothing is claimed or sent before a palm scan, per the workspace_owner on 2026-10-12.
Assets lists what the wallet holds on the app's three networks: USD Coin and Ether on Ethereum and Base, and DATA on DATA Network. Refresh at the right of the Assets heading reads the balances again. A balance that could not be read is never shown as 0. Keeping the last amounts on screen while it runs and after it fails is proposed; the app's loader replaces them with "Loading…" today.
Receive is a sheet: choose the network (Ethereum, DATA Network or Base), then that profile's address on that network, Copy address (it reads Copied after), Done. The sheet never says to send only one token.
Balance is read from the wallet. Nothing is added to it by the page: after a reward is paid, the balance is read again and the payment is in it.
The app's Mainnet and Testnet switch is drawn as a staging-only variant. Hiding it from members is a proposal and needs Send and Claim to work on Mainnet first, since the app offers both only in Testnet mode today.
Desktop: the sidebar stays, there is no footer, and the page is one column 640 wide. Receive, Send and Claim open as dialogs over it.
Follow-up, not a decision: Spec 014 §6.1 describes one portfolio added up across profiles and should be brought into line with this.
To draw: loading and error. A code to scan on Receive is optional.
Phone: nothing to claim (with DATA under Assets), something to claim, claimed and paid, empty. Then Switch profile, Receive, and Refresh with the staging-only network switch

Proposed, not what the app does: while refreshing, the amounts stay as they were, and after a failure the last amounts stay, marked as possibly out of date. Today the app offers Send and reward claims only in Testnet mode, so hiding the switch alone would leave production without them.
